title: Crossing Guard Shields Family: Las Vegas worker steps between car and children; dashcam video goes viral
summary_full: In a heart-stopping moment, a crossing guard in Las Vegas, Richard Jones, heroically leapt into action to save a mother and her children from an oncoming vehicle near Pinecrest Academy St. Rose. The shocking dashcam footage revealed how close they came to disaster. Grateful for his bravery, the family later returned to express their heartfelt thanks, emphasizing the inherent dangers faced by crossing guards in school zones.
